# UIPadding

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIPadding")`

Adds space inside each edge of its parent, around the parent's content. Parent it next to the content it affects.

The content is the parent's children and the parent's own text. The text of a `TextLabel` or `TextButton`, and the text, caret and placeholder of a `TextInput`, are positioned, wrapped, cut and scaled inside the padding.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PaddingBottom` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | The space inside the bottom edge. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's height. |
| `PaddingLeft` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | The space inside the left edge. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's width. |
| `PaddingRight` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | The space inside the right edge. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's width. |
| `PaddingTop` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | The space inside the top edge. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's height. |
